question: Safflower, shisham, khair, arjun and mulberry are the main trees of which vegetation?
solution:
The correct answer** 'Tropical Deciduous Forests.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tropical Deciduous Forests-**

 
 
• **​**They are called **monsoon forests.**
 
• **Rainfall** is in the range the range o**f 70-200 cm.**
 
• **A long dry season followed by heavy rainfall season** is a feature of the regions where these forests are found.
 
• There are two types of Deciduous Forests:
 
 
• **Moist Deciduous Forests – Mixture of Trees and Grasses**
 
• **Dry Deciduous Forests**
 
 
 
• As the name goes, tropical deciduous forests are found along the **Equator belt between the tropic of Cancer and tropic of Capricorn.**
 
• vegetation-**Teak , Sal , Shisham , Hurra , Mahua, Amla , Semul , Kusum , Sandalwood , khair , arjun , mulberry.**
 
• Major states where tropical deciduous forests are found:
 
 

 
• **Madhya Pradesh**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh**
 
• **Chattisgarh**
 
• **Odisha**
 
• **Maharashtra (Some Parts)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Montane Forests-**

 
 
• **​****Montane** ecosystems refer to any** ecosystem found in mountains. **
 
• **Dense** forests are common in areas of** moderate elevations.**
 
• **At higher elevations, the climate is harsher,** with lower temperatures and higher winds, preventing the growth of trees and causing the plant community to transition to montane grasslands, shrublands or alpine tundra.
 
• Some significant trees of a montane temperate forest are rhododendrons, ferns, oak, maple, juniper, deodar, chilgoza, etc.
 
 
 
• **Tropical evergreen forests:**
 
 
• **​**Tropical evergreen forests of India are found in the **Andaman and Nicobar Islands, the Western Ghats, which fringe the Arabian Sea, the coastline of peninsular India, and the greater Assam region in the north-east**. 
 
• Small remnants of evergreen forest are found in **Odisha state.**
 
• **​​Species-Ebony , Mahogany , Rosewood and Rubber Chinchona .**
 
• The tropical wet evergreen forest in India is usually found in areas receiving** more than 200 cm of rainfall** and having a **temperature of 15-30 degrees Celsius.**
 
• They occupy about** 7% of the earth’s surface.**
 
• They are found mostly near the equator.
 
 
 
• **Mangrove forests-**
 
 
• **​**They represent the** littoral forest ecosystem.**
 
• Low lying areas of tropical and subtropical regions **(Between 24 degrees North and 38 degrees South)** are home to Mangroves
 
• They are also called** Halophytes – They are salt-tolerant. **
 
• The trees that grow in Mangrove Forests are generally **8-20 meters high.** These trees have** thick leaves.**
 
• They are confined to tropical and subtropical regions as they **need high solar radiation **to filter saline water through their roots.
